Restored API and browser checks pass. Full local suite ran through pinned pm test (linked test 6, timeout 1200) under Node 26.13.0, fresh home, no global/system Git config, no credential environment, CI mode and two workers: passed in 307 seconds; all-source coverage 100/100/100/100 at unchanged thresholds. value.text: The initial packed verifier run failed because it treated the consumer directory as the package directory (missing dist). Fixed the verifier to resolve pm-brand/package.json through normal package resolution, and canonicalize installed/nested/symlinked module identities. Added a symlinked consumer regression to the main-relative browser test. Final focused compatibility checks pass 4/4, including baseline regeneration and the four adversarial reverts; the npm tarball passes original root/font-subpath report imports under Node and Bun. The complete isolated local suite will be rerun after this verifier correction. The application API implementation remains restored from main.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Packed validation is now green for both npm and Bun installs. Each captured-tarball install preserves all main export conditions, 69 names/signatures, 73 declaration records and 55 assets; the main-relative root browser graph gains no Node edge, dependency or reaching module. Each also passes five truly pure browser bundles and three additive Node-only browser refusals. Four Node/Bun runtime smoke consumers verify the original root and font-coverage report imports are the same function as the new alias. One Bun dependency-resolution attempt stalled and its owned child was terminated; the bounded retry passed. Installer calls now have a 180-second limit. Final full local isolated suite is running again after the verifier path correction; the first complete local run already passed at 100/100/100/100 coverage.
